$comment: Exchange rates used to compare a USD-quoted provider price against Zonatic's IDR pricing.
ASSUMPTION, NOT A LIVE RATE. There is no free, official, stable USD/IDR reference
rate to quote, so this value is a marketing-calculation assumption and is labelled
as such in the UI. It is deliberately not described as a live exchange rate.
To change it: edit `value` (and `checkedAt`) below. Nothing else needs to change —
calculator.ts, format.ts and the React component read this file and never mention

IDR.note: Kurs asumsi untuk perbandingan biaya di kalkulator. Bukan kurs pasar live dan dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu.
